source: Two probes of the dev-test LLM gateway's /v1/responses, model alias gpt-astra (the gateway resolves it to gpt-6.2-astra; its unsupported-value refusals name gpt-6.2-astra-2026-11-17), one request per exchange, sent by the maintainer's tooling.
provenance: Not a wirefixture candidate: the wire capture pipeline (internal/wirecapture) accepts only data-only SSE that ends with [DONE] and refuses event: lines, so a Responses stream cannot be recorded by it. This file is a hand-curated, sanitized excerpt of the probe records.

Verbatim from the records: the order and the field set of every item event (output_item.added/done, function_call_arguments.delta/done, content_part.added/done, output_text.delta/done, the reasoning item's added and done), the complete non-stream response of exchange json-text, the error bodies (kept as text, in the gateway's own key order, requestid replaced), and the requests that were sent (the long prompts, which the records cut, restored from the probe scripts). SSE frames carry an event: line equal to data.type.

Completed from json-text: the records cut the response object of each streamed response.created, response.in_progress and response.completed event at 1400 characters, so those objects were rebuilt from the complete non-stream response with the fields the records show (instructions, tools, reasoning, status, usage) replaced; the tools echo is rebuilt from the request. The shape of the rebuilt tail (top_logprobs, top_p, truncation, usage, user) and of the usage is therefore from json-text, not from a stream.

Sanitized: response, item and message IDs (resp_, fc_, msg_, rs_ and 50 characters, as the real ones), call IDs the upstream made (call_ and 24 characters), timestamps, prompt_cache_key, obfuscation padding and the gateway's requestid are fixed placeholders of the same shape. Call IDs the probe made up (msg_abc123_r1_tool_1, msg_x_r1_tool_1, nope_1, c_1) are kept as sent. The encrypted reasoning tokens (1.3 to 2.9 KB, beginning gAAAAAB) are short fixed placeholders that keep what the probe showed: the token of response.output_item.added is shorter than the one of response.output_item.done, the reasoning item of response.completed carries a third value of the done one's length, and the replay request carries the done item's value. No key, address or prompt text of a person is in the records.

Exchanges whose response is a summary instead of events (rewritten-call-accepted, reasoning-replay-accepted, reasoning-dropped-accepted): the request is what matters, and the answer was a text stream of the same shape as tool-output-stream; only the item types and the text are kept.

Not in the records, so not in this file: response.incomplete, response.failed, an error event inside a stream, response.refusal.delta, a reasoning summary event (the probes asked for no summary), and a stream line longer than the stream line bound. The fake builds those from the OpenAI documents and marks them constructed.

exchanges.name: reasoning-tool-stream
exchanges.note: Effort xhigh with a tool: the answer starts with a reasoning item (content and summary are empty arrays, encrypted_content is there, there is no status) at output_index 0 and the function_call follows at 1. The item of response.output_item.added already carries a (shorter) encrypted_content, the one of response.output_item.done the whole one, and the one of response.completed a third value of the done one's length. No reasoning summary event: no summary was requested.
